title: Chapter 490
paragraphs: Chapter 490
137. They all had good plans (1)
Swish-!

With a single swing of Joshua's sword, the bodies of five wizards were severed in half. Other wizards nearby attempted to flee but met their deaths without even a chance to scream in pain under the sword of the black knight, 'Jane.'
30 minutes had passed since they entered.
During that time, they had killed over 200 administrators and wizards, and unfortunately, they had also cut down more than thirty of Kinzelo's members and water people who had witnessed the carnage.
Already, reinforcements from Drakka and the 2nd Magic Tower had entered the underground shipyard.

Although they hadn't encountered each other yet because they were preoccupied with subduing Kinzelo and the shipyard was so vast, coupled with Joshua's party's excellent stealth abilities, it was only a matter of time before they were discovered.
Instead of continuing to move, Joshua and Jane shook off the blood and waited for the other black knights.
"Mon has arrived, 2nd Knight."
At Jane's words, Joshua turned his head. The black knight called Mon had been monitoring the situation with Jin, rather than moving with them over the past 20 minutes.
The reason Joshua instructed Mon to follow Jin was simple.
It was because he couldn't be sure whether Jin had grasped the existence of the blueprints in the 2nd Magic Tower.
"How did it seem?"
"He didn't take the shortest route to the 17th and 19th sectors. It seemed like he was closely observing Kinzelo's members' actions."
"Did you hear my siblings talking directly?"

"The 12th Knights' defenses were strict, and more Gifl support troops were continually being added. Above all, Murakan's senses were sharp, and it would have been a problem if I had approached even a little closer."
Even a black knight couldn't do everything.

It was impossible for a black knight to approach close enough to hear Jin, Murakan, and Diphus's conversations without being caught in this place. The fact that Mon could even catch a glimpse of their movements was because he was a black knight.
He was not using the shortest route.
Joshua went over that fact in his mind and nodded.
"We'd better assume that my youngest brother definitely knows about the existence of the blueprints in the 2nd Magic Tower and act accordingly. My bad feeling has come true."

"I agree. Even if he hadn't been aware of the 2nd Magic Tower at all, he would have figured it out after seeing Kinzelo's terror. The 12th Knight is a sharp and insightful person, so there's no way he could have missed it."
"From now on, we should actively use my youngest brother. Kinzelo's real players who are not involved in the terror will be sent to the 2nd Magic Tower anyway."
"It's been bothering me that we didn't share the information about the 2nd Magic Tower with the 4th and 12th Knights from the beginning."
"That won't be a problem, Mon Knight, Jane Knight. It wasn't just about monopolizing the credit that I didn't share the information about the 2nd Magic Tower with my siblings."
Joshua sincerely believed that Jin and Diphus's efforts to divert attention inside the shipyard would be much more helpful in acquiring the blueprints.
If only Kinzelo hadn't come out like this.

"Right. The real problem is that our information has been leaked to Kinzelo. I can only think of Yona Runcandel or the Nameless King as the ones capable of breaking through our guard and extracting information. The possibility of the Nameless one getting involved in this matter seems low."

"It's possible that the Kinzelo leader used a special power or that there was demonic involvement. The Prophet didn't reveal the location of the airship blueprint in that way either, without leaving any trace, completely unnoticed."

Although Mon and Jane responded like this, the truth was that there were traces of numerous people being used in the process of the Prophet discovering the location of the airship blueprint. Her prophecies and magic always used living humans as catalysts.
However, the two dark knights didn't know that much.
"We'll verify the leak path through the Prophet later."
Joshua fell into thought for a moment.

'Whatever the information leak route is, what's certain is that we're now competing with Kinzelo. And the youngest one... will probably try to take advantage of the gap between me and Kinzelo to steal from the 2nd Tower.'
For now, let's match the pace of the youngest one.
Joshua came to that conclusion.

'It might even be a good thing. My original plan was to infiltrate the 2nd Tower alone, without Kinzelo, so the involvement of the youngest one, Murakan, and Diphus could actually help. Besides, neither the youngest one nor Kinzelo will have this.'
Joshua reached into the pocket of his infiltration suit and clutched an object.
It was a key. The key to the 2nd Tower vault that Sandra Zipple had been wearing around her neck.
Before infiltrating the Sota Desert, the Prophet had perfectly copied the key while confirming the location and contents of the 2nd Tower's vault.
-'Without this key, it's impossible to quickly access the 2nd Tower's vault. There are hundreds of illusionary barriers and security spells in place. They won't activate if you have the key.'
-'Are you sure?'
-'When have I ever lied?'
-'Then why didn't you copy the blueprint itself?'

-'You're talking nonsense again. It wouldn't have been impossible if you had given me more materials. I made the infiltration suit and key with the scarce materials I had, and I even told you the location of the vault. Do you think the dead Rontel Gius Ramfen could have done this?'
-'...What did you say?'

-'You thought I wouldn't know you were relying on that demon? I was just turning a blind eye to your pathetic and ridiculous actions. This time, you must succeed and bring back the airship blueprint and the item.'
The conversation he had with the Prophet before departing came to mind.

'I didn't expect the Prophet to know about Ramfen, but it doesn't matter now. The youngest one will reveal the true nature of the spirit orb instead, and if it turns out to be as significant as my intuition, I can take it away then.'
The Prophet had been Joshua's greatest weapon, despite constantly nagging and scratching his pride, and even showing signs of betrayal.

'Besides, if Kinzelo's special ability users, including the leader, had powers that were superior or comparable to the Prophet's, they would have stolen not only the operation time but also this key.'
Joshua was still the most likely one to steal the items from the 2nd Tower.
As his thoughts organized, he felt relieved that the situation would once again move according to his calculations.
"Sir Mon."
Joshua spoke as he sheathed his sword.
"Speak, second knight."
"Let's stop pretending and move quickly. Knight Mon, from now on, draw the attention of the Zipels."

Although Joshua and his party had already killed more than two hundred administrators, magicians, and over thirty Kinzelos, they were still on a covert mission. The assassinations were just a result of the terror.
Joshua's words meant to stop infiltrating and start destroying.
Even if they were just one person, they were a Black Knight.
If the lower-ranking Kinzelos running amok in the construction site were fish, then the Black Knight was a whale. The little fish could not surpass their presence.
"Knight Jane and I will head straight to the second tower. After the destruction, join us if possible, but prioritize survival and escape."
"Understood."
"And let me know the path the youngest and his party took. It's time to coordinate with him once again."
Halt.
Jin's party, who were running at full speed, stopped simultaneously. They detected a sudden strong energy and explosion, as if a thorn had popped out.
Although the terror continued, it was a change that anyone with a heightened sense could feel.
"Hey, what's going on? Did any of the Kinzelos we've caught have this much energy? With this level of vibration, it seems like a couple of areas on the other side have disappeared altogether."
"It's in the direction of areas 4 and 11, Lord Murakan. Since Joshua and the Black Knights were there, it could be a battle between them and the reinforcements."
"...No, I don't feel any magical power, second brother. If an explosion of this scale was caused by magic, the flow of magical power in the construction site should have changed."
"Then, Joshua could have really attacked areas 4 and 11."
"As I suspected, Joshua might have left a Black Knight in the construction site to cause trouble."
"Is the Black Knight pretending to have really attacked areas 4 and 11, and Joshua is trying to take advantage of the gap to go to the second tower?"
Originally, that would have been an excessive speculation. However, Diphus had decided to trust Jin after witnessing Joshua's decision to proceed with the mission. At least for this mission.

"Anyway, from now on, the Zipple reinforcements will be drawn there. It means the optimal moment for us to enter the second tower is approaching. Let's wait and see if the vibration gets farther or closer."
The vibration was rapidly moving away.
"It seems like it's really the Black Knight..."
Jin, who was about to say that, suddenly held his breath and put his index finger to his lips. Murakan and Diphus also hurriedly hid their presence.
A distant scream was heard.

Jin's party was currently near Area 17, and like Joshua's party, they had killed most of the Zipels and Kinzelos up to this point. In particular, they had not spared a single magician who came to support from the second tower.

In other words, there weren't many people left alive near District 17, so there shouldn't have been any sound of someone running at an incredibly fast pace, unless it was newly arrived reinforcements.
'The sound of footsteps is too sparse for it to be reinforcements. And the footsteps are too fast. It's like trained warriors are sprinting at full speed, not magicians.'
Someone was slaughtering the remnants in the vicinity of District 17 and heading towards Jin's group.
Diphus and Murakan could also feel the sound of the footsteps, recklessly rushing without caution.
And a moment later.
The group, hiding in the pipes at the entrance of District 17, was able to confirm the sight of two shadows disappearing at the speed of light.
"It's Joshua and the Black Knight...!"
Diphus was the first to speak.
There was only one Black Knight. He was on the edge of his nerves, realizing that the youngest's prediction had been accurate once again.
"Oh, kid. Just as you said."
Murakan whistled in amazement, but Jin had a slightly stiff face, unlike the other two.
"It might not be something to be happy about, Brother Diphus."
Diphus raised a question mark in his eyes.
"Why?"

"While it's true that they left one Black Knight to draw attention and infiltrated the Second Tower during that time, doesn't it seem like they headed towards the Second Tower as if they wanted us to see it?"
"Uh-huh."

"If they're sprinting, it means they have to go that fast, of course. Although this area is close to the path to the Second Tower, there's a separate shortest route. In other words, Joshua should have used another route, not this one."
Listening to Jin, it made sense.
"If what you say is true, then Joshua must have been tracking our movement path while following us."
"Murakan, couldn't it just be that they were running hastily without any particular thought?"
"Murakan, didn't you say earlier that something seemed to be chasing us?"
"Well, yeah, I did. I was a bit skeptical about it."
"And didn't Brother Diphus and I also have that feeling?"
There was a moment of silence.

"... Huh, well. I don't know about Joshua, but the Black Knight could have been able to verify our movement path from a distance. Then why? The purpose of verifying our movement path must be to secretly enter the Second Tower, right? There's no reason to reveal it on purpose."
As Diphus spoke in frustration, Jin sank into thought for a moment.

"I'm not sure, it's probably because they have some kind of confidence that they're doing this. What that is... honestly, I can't think of it right away. It seems like it's our turn to be led by Joshua this time."
